segments.name: Nutritious Snacking
segments.description: Develops, markets and sells protein-rich, low-carbohydrate snacks and meal replacements under Quest, Atkins and OWYN brands.
segments.evidence: The product portfolio we develop, market and sell consists primarily of protein bars, ready-to-drink ("RTD") protein shakes, sweet and salty protein snacks and confectionery products marketed under the Quest, Atkins, and OWYN brand names.

revenueModel.text: Retailers and distributors purchase nutritious snacking products across grocery, club, mass merchandise, e-commerce, convenience and specialty retail channels.
revenueModel.evidence: We distribute our products in major retail channels, primarily in North America, including grocery, club, and mass merchandise, and through e-commerce, convenience, specialty, and other channels.

changes.text: In 2024, the company acquired Only What You Need, Inc., adding the OWYN brand to its portfolio.
changes.evidence: we acquired Only What You Need, Inc. in June 2024.
